text: dsh-sidebar-expand-all 是面向 DSH 桌面版的会话侧栏插件，通过修改桌面 app.asar 内的客户端代码，让用户点一次「展开其余会话」即可显示当前工作区全部会话，并让「收起」后固定显示五个会话。插件提供本机状态页面，可应用补丁、查看状态或还原官方文件，也会安装配套 skill 和命令行脚本。适合希望快速浏览大量工作区会话的 DSH 桌面用户；应用补丁后需完全重启 DSH。

dsh-sidebar-expand-all patches the DSH desktop client so one click reveals every session in a workspace and collapse returns to five. Its local page can apply or restore the patch and show its status; it also installs a companion skill and CLI. Restart DSH after applying.
我想一次展开当前工作区里所有会话。
侧栏会话每次只能多显示五个，有办法一次全部打开吗？
让桌面端 DSH 的收起列表始终回到五个会话。
我想在页面上检查侧栏补丁状态并恢复原文件。
Can I reveal every session in a workspace with a single click?
I need a desktop sidebar that collapses back to five sessions.
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 的「全部展开」功能：点击侧栏的展开操作后，将当前工作区会话显示上限设为无限，让剩余会话一次全部出现。
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 的「收起至五个」功能：点击收起后固定使用五个会话的显示基线，侧栏仅显示五个会话。
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 提供本机状态页面：在 DSH 的对应页面查看补丁状态，并通过按钮应用补丁或还原官方文件。
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 安装配套 skill：插件加载时将说明文件和命令行脚本复制到用户级 DSH skills 目录，供 agent 会话使用。
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 提供独立命令行操作：可检查补丁状态、列出内置补丁、应用补丁或从备份还原。
dsh-sidebar-expand-all 使用前须知：仅支持桌面版；应用后需重启 DSH，插件会安装 skill 和脚本到用户目录。见 lib/index.js:30-59、lib/index.js:152-180
工作区会话太多，想点一次就把隐藏的都显示出来。
DSH 桌面侧栏能不能收起时固定只留五条会话？

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · dsh-sidebar-expand-all：One-click **expand all** for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — and a strict **collapse to 5**.

DSH 侧栏一次只展开 5 个会话；这个插件让「展开其余 N 个会话」点一次就展开该工作区**全部**会话，点「收起」严格回到 5 个。

> 中文说明见 [README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)。

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · What it changes：DSH stores a per-workspace "watermark": how many sessions of a group are visible. The upstream UI advances it by `SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE = 5` on every click, and the collapsed baseline is raised whenever a running or unread session must stay visible.

This plugin applies two **same-length** patches to the bundled client at

```
app.asar
└─ dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace/lib/client.js
```

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · What it changes：| Patch | Official code | Patched code | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand-all` | `visible.hiddenCount <= SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE ? Infinity : watermark + SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE` | `Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY` | one click reveals every remaining session |
| `collapse-to-5` | `Math.max(SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE, requiredWatermark(...))` | `SESSION_WATERMARK_BASE` | collapse always shows exactly 5 |

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · What it changes：Both replacements are padded with spaces so the file size does not change, and the entry's `integrity.hash` (and `blocks[0].hash`) in the asar header is updated in place. Any change to file length would corrupt every following entry in the archive.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Install：From the plugin market / npm (after publishing):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sidebar-expand-all
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-sidebar-expand-all
```

Or add the repository directly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:mzjqwq/dsh-sidebar-expand-all
```

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Web page：After DSH starts, open

```
http://127.0.0.1:<your DSH port>/dsh-sidebar-expand-all
```

You get the current patch status plus **Apply**, **Restore** and **Refresh** buttons.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · CLI：```bash
node scripts/patch-workspace-expand-all.mjs --check    # inspect only
node scripts/patch-workspace-expand-all.mjs            # apply (idempotent)
node scripts/patch-workspace-expand-all.mjs --list     # list built-in patches
node scripts/patch-workspace-expand-all.mjs --restore  # restore official file

Exit codes: `0` ok · `2` asar or backup missing · `3` file/header integrity mismatch (refused) · `4` check found inconsistent header.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Restart is required：The DSH host caches every client bundle in memory at startup, and `dsh-client-hmr` keeps seeing the startup-time `stat` of files inside `app.asar`, so **editing the asar cannot hot-reload**. Fully quit DSH and open it again (a page refresh is not enough).

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Safety：- Files are never resized: patches are equal-length and verified by re-reading the entry and its header hash.
- The original `client.js` and the original asar header are backed up to `~/.dsh/dsh-sidebar-expand-all/.asar-bak/` before the first write (`DSH_BAK` overrides).
- Restore writes the backup back and re-checks that backup header and content match.
- If the current content does not match the header integrity (another tool already modified the archive), the apply step aborts instead of guessing.
- If a patch anchor is missing, the plugin reports `unsupported` and writes nothing — it never guesses a replacement.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Upgrades：A DSH upgrade replaces `app.asar` as a whole, so the patch disappears. Re-run **Apply** (or the CLI) after upgrading. If the anchors changed in a new DSH release, the status becomes `unsupported`; the two expressions above must then be re-located in the new `client.js`.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Bundled skill：The plugin also installs a user-level skill to `~/.dsh/skills/dsh-sidebar-expand-all/`, so an agent session can perform the same check/apply/restore without the web page.

dsh-sidebar-expand-all README · Development：```bash
node --check lib/asar-patch.js
node --check lib/index.js
node scripts/patch-workspace-expand-all.mjs --check
```

`lib/asar-patch.js` is dependency-free and can be used outside the plugin.
